description: Land Title Settlement Department - Keenawinna, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510082
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Nos. 265 and 266), including detailed ownership information, property descriptions, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
